Mobs.LongDescription: A confused worker can't understand what his friends are saying.
Mobs.Description:
This worker has a confused look on his face. He doesn't seem to
understand what is going on. For some reason, he has stopped building,
just as everyone else. He tries to say something, but noone seems to
understand him. Just what has happened here?
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 say Blaczego nikt mnie nierozumie? Co sie dzieje?;%10 scratch;%5 shrug;%5 frown

Mobs.Name: sainte lucia
Mobs.LongDescription: Sainte Lucia walks around, enjoying the good weather.
Mobs.Description:
Sainte Lucia is truly beautiful, in her white dress and the candles in
her hair. While alive, she brought food to christian prisoners. She held
the food in her hands, and because of that there was no way for her to
hold the candles so she made a small crown to give her light enough to
see. She took this crown with her to Heaven. Too bad she was executed.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 smile;%5 sigh;%5 stare

Mobs.Name: worker
Mobs.LongDescription: A confused worker can't understand what his friends are saying.
Mobs.Description:
This worker has a confused look on his face. He doesn't seem to
understand what is going on. For some reason, he has stopped building,
just as everyone else. He tries to say something, but noone seems to
understand him. Just what has happened here?
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 say Sta je zasto me nitko ne razumije? Pricaj bre srpsi da te ceo svet razume!;%10 scratch;%5 shrug;%5 frown

Objects.Name: spear heavenly
Objects.Description: A heavenly spear has been left here by it's owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This spear looks like any normal spear with religious origin,
but when you touch it you feel that this spear came right
down from Heaven!

Objects.Name: golden armor plate heavenly
Objects.Description: A golden plated armor like this one should be quite valuable...

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This plate is obviously made mostly for the looks - it doesn't
look very protective.

Objects.Name: angel halo heavenly
Objects.Description: There is an angel's heavenly halo busy spreading goodness here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It's a glowing circle that is usually hovering above ones head,
symbolizing goodness.

Objects.Name: plain dress white heavenly
Objects.Description:
A plain white dress is lying forgotten on the ground with noone
to wear it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This dress should be worn by an angel. Where is the angel now?

Objects.Name: wing wings heavenly
Objects.Description:
A pair of wings is flapping, trying to take off, but they need
someone to wear them.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These heavenly wings are angel wings, the kind you get when
you enter Heaven. Either someone stole them or ripped them off
some poor angel.

Objects.Name: heavenly hand god
Objects.Description: The mighty hand of God is unbelievably enough within your reach!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the hand of God, the ultimate tool of divine power.
Wield this and you have an unbelievably powerful weapon!

Objects.Name: flaming sword gabriel heavenly
Objects.Description: Gabriel's flaming sword is ready to toast some demons!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This sword can turn your enemies to roasted bread, and your evil enemies
to coal. But remember, it was meant only for Gabriel to use...

Objects.Name: shield protection heavenly michael
Objects.Description: Michael has created this shield to protect from foul evilness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This shield was created by Michael to protect it's user against any kind
of injuries - magical or physical. It works rather well.

Objects.Name: key staff moses wooden
Objects.Description: The staff Moses used to divide the ocean in half wants to do it again!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This staff was once used by Moses to divide the ocean in half, letting
his people flee from the egyptians. The staff still has got some power
left in it...

Objects.Name: healers healer's gloves heavenly raphael
Objects.Description: These heavenly gloves have special healing powers, waiting to be used.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These gloves were once worn by Raphael to give him greater healing powers
(not that he needed any help). Of course, you could use them just as well.

Objects.Name: ring treason lucifer heavenly
Objects.Description: Lucifer's lesser ring of treason might be useful in sneaky occasions.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is Lucifer's lesser ring of treason. Good to have if you want to
spy on people or sneak up on them.

Objects.Name: damned ring treason lucifer heavenly
Objects.Description: Unfortunately, Lucifer's greater ring of treason is damned.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This ring was cursed by God when Lucifer tried to infiltrate Heaven by
using the ring, so it lost its special powers.

Objects.Name: dragon slayer lance george heavenly
Objects.Description: The lance saint George used to slay the dragon wants some reptile blood!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This lance was once used by saint George to slay the evil dragon that was
about to eat the beautiful princess. The bravery of saint George still
remains in this powerful lance - the dragons will have to watch out for
anyone wielding this weapon!

Objects.Name: dragon shield george heavenly
Objects.Description: Pick this dragon shield up and no fire will harm you no more!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This was the shield saint George used as protection when he fought the evil
dragon. It has been given special abilities that will protect against
the fire of dragons...

Objects.Name: grail holy heavenly
Objects.Description: The holy grail is waiting to be quaffed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The grail is made of gold, with really nice patterns in it. Noone but a
pure genius of art could have made this, or a really good magician.

Objects.Name: big sack nicholaus heavenly
Objects.Description: This big sack could probably contain a whole mountain of loot.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the sack saint Nicholas keeps all his stuff in. As the patron
saint of the thieves, he's got to have something to keep his loot in.

Objects.Name: santas santa lantern heavenly nicholas
Objects.Description: A lantern spread its warm light in the room.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This lantern is designed not only to spread light around the holder, but
also a feeling of peace. The holder will feel faster, healthier and more
self-confident with this lantern lit.

Objects.Name: crown candles lucia heavenly
Objects.Description: This crown made out of candles should be worn with pride.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This crown was worn by sainte Lucia as a light source, since she had her
hands full with bread and water for the christian prisoners in the roman
dungeons. Too bad they executed her...

Objects.Name: scythe death apocalyptic
Objects.Description:
#rDeath#G's dark scythe is within your reach. Dare you wield this evil
tool of destruction?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the uttermost evil tool of chaotic destruction you will ever have
the opportunity to lay your hands on. Nothing withstands the power of the
first horseman, Death, and his scythe.

Objects.Name: cape death apocalyptic
Objects.Description:
The apocalyptic cape of the horseman #rDeath#G is waiting to be worn by
some foolish adventurer.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look at this cape, you can almost see the skull face of #rDeath#N
staring at you from the black weave. You hear his wicked laugh, sense his
foul evilness... Is this truly the fate of mankind?

Objects.Name: axe war apocalyptic
Objects.Description: You see the axe of #RWar#G, the second of the apocalyptic horsemen.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Blood is dripping from the blade of this cruel double bladed axe. The runes engraved on it seems to absorb the surrounding light in their foulness. Be careful with this axe!

Objects.Name: plate war apocalyptic
Objects.Description: The plate of #RWar#G seems to be absorbing all magic around it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This plate will render it's wearer nearly invincible, even to arcane
powers!

Objects.Name: helmet war apocalyptic
Objects.Description: A war helmet has been abandoned on the ground here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This helmet was made by warriors, for warriors, and any sorcerer trying
to use it will soon loose a great deal of his powers.

Objects.Name: disease dagger pestilence apocalyptic
Objects.Description: Flies circle around a dagger that someone left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the dagger used by #GPestilence#N - the third horseman of the
Apocalypse. Be very careful with using this dagger - it's not only
bad for your enemies.

Objects.Name: potion flask chemical
Objects.Description: You notice a small flask filled with chemicals that has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Oh, just a small flask filled with chemicals.

Objects.Name: key death black apocalyptic
Objects.Description:
A black key with the name of #rDeath#G written upon it is waiting to be 
picked up.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The key has the word #rDeath#N written upon it, and some runes which are impossible for you to translate.

Objects.Name: key war blood red apocalyptic
Objects.Description:
A blood red key with the name of #RWar#G written upon it is waiting to be 
picked up.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The key has the word #RWar#N written upon it, and some runes which are impossible for you to translate.

Objects.Name: key pestilence green apocalyptic
Objects.Description:
A green key with the name of #GPestilence#G written upon it is waiting to 
be picked up.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The key has the word #GPestilence#N written upon it, and some runes which are impossible for you to translate.

Objects.Name: key famine pale grey apocalyptic
Objects.Description:
A pale grey key with the name of #wFamine#G written upon it is waiting to 
be picked up.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The key has the word #wFamine#N written upon it, and some runes which are impossible for you to translate.

Objects.Name: key petrus heavenly
Objects.ShortDescription: Saint Petrus' key to the gates of Heaven
Objects.Description: A great white key bears promises of eternal pleasure.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This key rightfully belongs to saint Petrus, and should be used by noone
but him. How come you have it in your hands?
